channel.title: The Night Desk
channel.description: News for the Graveyard Crew — true crime, breaking news, and the stories that keep you up at night.

item.title: Manhunt crosses state lines: escaped Tennessee murder convict's stolen truck found abandoned in Illinois
item.description: Jacob Allen Morley, 28, serving life for the 2022 murder of his coworker Cody Birchfield, escaped a Tennessee prison Sunday night. The truck he stole was found abandoned early Tuesday in Marion, Illinois — Morley himself is still missing, and the TBI is offering up to $2,500 for information leading to his arrest.

item.title: Nearly 40 years later: arrest in the 1986 Spokane cold-case murder of Mary Ann Turner
item.description: DNA preserved under Mary Ann Turner's fingernails — and a licked envelope from a police ruse — led Spokane detectives to David Tibbett, 74, charged with second-degree murder nearly four decades after she was found dead in a Spokane alley.

item.title: 15-year-old Mina Kurdian killed at home in Arcadia; ex, 20, hospitalized after shooting himself as police moved in
item.description: Mina Kurdian, 15, was found shot dead Thursday morning in her Arcadia home. Her family says her 20-year-old ex showed up drunk at 5 a.m., was kicked out, then returned and shot through a window to get in.

item.title: VERDICT: Guilty on all counts — the 14-year Faith Hedgepeth cold case finally gets its answer
item.description: A Durham jury convicted Miguel Salguero-Olivares of murder, rape, sexual offense and burglary in the 2012 killing of UNC student Faith Hedgepeth. Life without parole — 5,158 days after she died.

item.title: VERDICT: Rodney Hinton Jr. convicted of murder in the deputy-killing crash that shook Cincinnati
item.description: The jury rejected his insanity defense — and convicted him of murder, reckless homicide and felonious assault in the death of Deputy Larry Henderson. Sentencing is November 16.

item.title: Charged — Five Months Later: 69-Year-Old North Carolina Woman Arrested in Husband's May Death
item.description: Dale Ann Carr, 69, was arrested October 23 and charged with first-degree murder in the May 30 death of her husband Paul Carr. She told investigators he shot himself — deputies found him with gunshot wounds to the head, arm, and wrist, eight shell casings in the house, and the home's security cameras cut off earlier that day.

item.title: Seven Killed in Attack on Church Funeral in Jordan; Manhunt Underway
item.description: Gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church in Hamoud village, Jordan's Karak governorate, on Friday, October 23, killing seven people and wounding 34. Interior Minister Mazen al-Faraya called it an unprecedented terrorist act. No group has claimed responsibility.

item.title: 40 Years Later: Guilty Verdict in the Christmas Eve 1985 Killing of Leslie McCray
item.description: David Nelson Austin, 65, was convicted of first-degree murder, kidnapping and sexual battery in the 1985 abduction and killing of 17-year-old UNF student Leslie McCray. The case sat cold for decades until DNA testing matched Austin in a Michigan corrections database.

item.title: One Killed, Four Wounded in Paris-Suburb Drive-By Shooting; Suspect Arrested
item.description: A gunman opened fire from a vehicle in Trappes and La Verrière on Friday morning, killing one person and wounding at least four, including a 12-year-old girl. A 39-year-old suspect was arrested; France's anti-terrorism prosecutors are probing a possible racist motive.

item.title: FBI Foils Alleged ISIS-Linked Plot by 17-Year-Old to Assassinate Rep. Keith Self
item.description: Federal agents arrested a 17-year-old Texas boy accused of plotting to assassinate Rep. Keith Self at a public event and carry out a separate ISIS-inspired attack in North Texas. The arrest happened Oct. 5 — the news broke publicly this week.

item.title: Brother Charged With Murder in Stabbing Death of 15-Year-Old Trenton Grant, Monroe Township
item.description: Tyson Grant, 27, faces open murder plus four life-maximum felonies in the Oct. 17 stabbing inside a burning mobile home on Raintree Boulevard that killed his brother, a Monroe High sophomore, and seriously hurt their mother and stepfather.

item.title: Arrested after an 11-day manhunt: Akkini McDade, 24, charged with murder in Lubbock shooting that killed Delton Lewis
item.description: A $5,000 reward, U.S. Marshals, and hundreds of overnight man-hours — how an 11-day manhunt ended with a murder arrest in East Lubbock.

item.title: First-Degree Murder Verdict in 2022 Paxton Woods Case
item.description: A Worcester jury convicted Christopher Fuller of first-degree murder in the 2022 shooting of Ernest A. Appiah, whose body was found by a dog walker in the Paxton woods.

item.title: Virginia State Sen. L. Louise Lucas Indicted on Federal Racketeering, Marijuana Charges
item.description: The 82-year-old Senate president pro tempore surrendered Thursday as the DOJ unsealed a 45-page indictment charging her and six others — including two of her daughters and a grandson — with running an alleged illegal cannabis business and laundering its proceeds. AG Todd Blanche and FBI Director Kash Patel announced the charges at a Norfolk press conference.

item.title: National Guard Soldier Shot While Breaking Up Fight in Washington, D.C.
item.description: Guard members tried to intervene in a sidewalk fight in southeast D.C. around 11:10 p.m. Sunday when an armed man opened fire — one Guardsman was struck in the leg and the suspect was shot in the abdomen. Both survived.

item.title: Louisiana Man Arrested on 510 Counts of Sex Crimes Against Children, Including First-Degree Rape
item.description: Shayne Austin Stewart, 33, of Pioneer, Louisiana, was arrested on 510 criminal counts — including 10 counts of first-degree rape of two children under 8 — after investigators say he photographed and recorded the abuse himself.

item.title: Government Websites Across Europe Go Dark Over Critical PHP Flaws
item.description: Two critical vulnerabilities in PHP — rated 9.2 out of 10, allowing attackers to run code without logging in — sent government, hospital and school websites across Europe offline as operators scrambled to patch.

item.title: Suspect in Seattle Gas Station Clerk's Killing Arrested in Chicago
item.description: Michael Oneal Fleming, 33, was arrested Tuesday evening in Chicago by U.S. Marshals after a week on the run. He's charged with first-degree murder in the Oct. 13 shooting of former co-worker Graeme Dobbeck, 36, at a Seattle 76 station — and Kenosha police call him a person of interest in a separate death investigation.

item.title: Aggravated Murder Charge Filed in Atwater Township Shooting Death
item.description: A woman was shot dead at an Atwater Township home Tuesday morning. Travis C. Lovett, 21, fled to I-77 and was run down by troopers in Guernsey County; he's charged with aggravated murder.

item.title: 12-Year Fugitive Anna Somoza Caught in Mexico in Cold-Case Murder of 4-Year-Old Crystal Reyes
item.description: After 12 years on the run, Anna Marlene Somoza, 60, was detained in Xochitepec, Mexico, to face first-degree murder charges in the 1997 death of her 4-year-old daughter. Her former boyfriend was already convicted and is serving life.
